summary: FedEx filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $1.1 billion offering of 5.750% senior unsecured notes due September 30, 2036, priced at par with semi-annual interest beginning March 30, 2027. The notes are fully and unconditionally guaranteed by named subsidiary guarantors, rank pari passu with existing unsubordinated debt, and carry a 101% change-of-control repurchase put with optional redemption at stated prices. FedEx also markets euro-denominated tranches via a separate supplement, not cross-conditioned. This is a routine investment-grade debt capital raise, not a special situation; watch leverage, rates, and refinancing needs.
